name: FireSourcery_Library
description: Embedded C library (C23, arm-none-eabi-gcc, Cortex-M0+/M4) with a field-oriented motor control stack for bare-metal MCU targets: no RTOS, no heap after init, fixed-point at runtime. Generic Math, Framework and Type primitives, a Peripheral abstraction with a per-chip HAL, and Transducer algorithms sit beneath the Motor, MotorController and MotProtocol layers. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
